description: This file defines an abstract class for AWS SDK client-side monitoring middleware, handling request and response event data collection, socket communication for monitoring data, and middleware invocation logic within the AWS SDK PHP implementation.

classes.name: AbstractMonitoringMiddleware
classes.description: An abstract class implementing middleware for AWS SDK client-side monitoring, managing event data collection, socket communication, and middleware invocation.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a specific header value from an AwsException response, if available.

methods.name: getResultHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a specific header value from a result's metadata headers.

methods.name: getExceptionHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a specific header value from an exception that may contain a response.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a handler, credential provider, options, region, and service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware logic when processing a command and request, collecting event data, and handling promises.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID from options.

methods.name: getNewEvent
methods.description: Creates a new monitoring event array with command and request information.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region associated with the middleware.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service name associated with the middleware.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if monitoring is enabled based on unwrapped options.

methods.name: populateRequestEventData
methods.description: Populates event data with information from the request and command.

methods.name: populateResultEventData
methods.description: Populates event data with information from the response or exception.

methods.name: isSocketCreated
methods.description: Checks if the UDP socket is created, handling PHP version differences.

methods.name: prepareSocket
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a UDP socket resource for sending monitoring data.

methods.name: sendEventData
methods.description: Sends monitoring event data via UDP socket.

methods.name: unwrappedOptions
methods.description: Unwraps options if needed to access the configuration.
